# Topic 7: Virtual Field Trip to Parys Mine

![Topic 7 Cover image](./assets/images/parys.png)

For this topic, you will take a virtual field trip to Parys Mine in Anglesey, Wales.

This section will contain a link to the virtual field trip, and the suggested reading for the week.



## Virtual Field Trip
Virtual Field Trip: [Virtual Field Trip to Parys Mine](https://navigatorgeospatial.ie/vft/parys.html)



## Reading

I suggest reading [Chapter 16](https://opengeology.org/textbook/16-energy-and-mineral-resources/) of Johnson, C., Affolter, M.D., Inkenbrandt, P., and Mosher, C. (2017) An Introduction to Geology. USA: Salt Lake Community College. This is the chapter on Energy and Mineral Resources, and will help you to understand Parys mine. 


## Additional

There is much more information about Parys Mine online: I suggest the website of the Anglesey Underground group, which has a lot of information about the history, industry, and people as well as the mine itself: [https://www.parysmountain.co.uk/](https://www.parysmountain.co.uk/)
